revision_summary: No fabricated quotes were found — all Stage 3 quotes check out against the transcript. However, two targeted fixes are needed: (1) Schema misuse — cherry_pick_moments' 'prior_contact_probe_miss' at 02:04 cites rebuttals.already_saw_design, which is the wrong schema hook (that rebuttal is for competitive quote objections in new-install contexts). The correct reference is orphaned_flow's prior-company question ('What company did you go with originally?'), and the anchoring moment should shift to 00:44 ('We so we were with Fluent Solar') where the customer first names the prior installer — this is the actual trigger point Stage 3 missed entirely as a cherry-pick moment. (2) Missed moment — at 01:15 the rep asks 'Is she she looking into solar too?' immediately after being told Mary Anne already co-owns the existing system; this is a sharper, more concrete illustration of rep unpreparedness/fact-tracking failure than the co-owner title stumble at 01:02 that Stage 3 elevated to coaching_focus priority 2, and should either replace or supplement that entry. Additionally, soften the tone on coaching_focus[2] — the 01:02 title correction is a minor self-corrected stumble, not evidence of a broadly 'unprepared rep,' and pairing it with the 01:15 fact-tracking miss would better calibrate severity. These are surgical fixes; the core trajectory read (energy_leaked, rep stuck in new-install script against a non-standard removal/reinstall need, four unanswered direct questions, polite exit) is well-supported and should not be redone.
